detail.longDescription: I can now yell at a self hosted smart speaker "Alexa, play Taylor Swift" and that will go to my local Hermes Agent which via Unsloth local AI will dig through my Music Assistant connected to my 172TB media archive for her music and then feed it right back to the smart speaker I yelled at. Now that's a win for solar powered local AI home automation. # selfhosted # selfhosting # hermesagent # homeassistant # homelab
